digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage logging and run-shape recording
propositions: LLM gate runs compute tool-call and distinct-signature counts via failure_usage() but discard them at the write, violating the module's own cited docstring contract that failure rows carry what was actually consumed
LLM gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing at all to disk, forcing operators to re-run instrumented gates to answer usage questions instead of querying a durable log
The success path never computes tool-call shape, making successful runs indistinguishable from looping ones in the durable record, breaking the loop-vs-breadth tuning advice in docs/llm-framework.md

The seven keys (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, finish_reason) that are already computed by failure_usage() must be persisted to disk by wiring the existing reducer, not by building a second mechanism

A gate run must default-record to .rebar/usage.jsonl when inside a gate session and REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset, resolving the repo root from CWD not from the gate's code snapshot so the log is retrievable from the operator's checkout
The summarize() command must render total and distinct tool-call counts in a new Run shape table, making the loop-vs-breadth signal actionable for the first time without re-running
